description: 19 Part E — the twelve-curse catalogue (id, flavour, effect, paired reward) and the chapter-gating column the M3 kickoff resolved for O13 (`19` Part E line 320 calls the gating only a 'suggestion' and never marks it 🔒; the kickoff accepted it as the ruling anyway, so it is authored here as a real value, not left null). 🔒 Content transcription only: `effect` and `reward` are the design doc's own prose, not effect-DSL ops. The mechanical implementation — no-stacking, paired-reward payout, the AD_SKIP_CURSE hook, mount immunity — is M3-11's rules engine (tracked by GapRegister.Deferred's 'Curses' entry, keyed on Core's CurseDefinition), which is expected to read this file rather than restate it.

curses.description: 19 Part E — exactly twelve, ids unique.

effect.description: 19 Part E's Effect column, verbatim. The forced debuff a landed TILE_CURSE (or an authored APPLY_CURSE outcome, 03 §5) applies.

reward.description: 19 Part E's Reward column, verbatim. Curses pay — the debuff is never free.

availableFromChapter.description: O13 (resolved at the M3 kickoff): the earliest chapter this curse can be drawn in. 1-4 (CUR_SLIPPERY, CUR_MARKED, CUR_DIZZY, CUR_FRACTURED) open from Chapter 1; CUR_HUNTED specifically from Chapter 5; the remaining seven open from Chapter 3.
